主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. reported 2019 net income and FFO, and announced a three-for-two stock split. The report was filed on February 13, 2020, as part of a Form 6-K filing with the SEC. The filing includes details about the company's financial performance and corporate actions. The stock split is a corporate action that affects the number of shares outstanding and the price per share. The company's financial results and corporate actions are relevant to investors and market participants. The filing is part of the company's ongoing disclosure obligations under U.S. securities laws. The report was signed by Justin Beber, Head of Corporate Strategy and Chief Legal Officer of Brookfield Asset Management Inc..
